input_fields.name: earliest_failure
input_fields.description: Captured first error, stage, source location, run reference, and observed state.

input_fields.name: error_category_definitions
input_fields.description: Versioned category definitions and evidence predicates.

result_fields.name: failure_classification
result_fields.description: One category, supporting fields, confidence, and unresolved items.

result_fields.name: needs_manual_review
result_fields.description: True when evidence does not distinguish one category.

procedure: Compare stage, API/source location, state, and message against category predicates.
Return one classification with supporting references and confidence; retain competing categories when unresolved.
Set needs_manual_review when two categories remain plausible or no definition matches.
Keep repair selection outside this classification atom.
rejection_rules: Reject missing chronology, unversioned definitions, or classification from a later cascade error.
Do not convert a category guess into a repair.
Do not hide missing evidence in a generic category.
